preconditions.description: The number of rows must be a positive integer.
The number of columns must be a positive integer.

postconditions.description: The result must have the same number of rows as specified.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == columns for row in result)
postconditions.description: Each row in the result must have the same number of columns as specified.
The first element of the first row must be 'O'.

postconditions.expression: all(result[i][j] == ('O' if (i + j) % 2 == 0 else 'X') for i in range(rows) for j in range(columns))
postconditions.description: Each element in the result must alternate between 'O' and 'X' based on its position.
